draftBefore.emotion: warm and anticipating a celebration, reflecting on a personal milestone
notes: In Chinese, you don't 'have' a birthday; you 'pass' (过) it. So you would say '我过生日' (I am celebrating my birthday).
Note the difference between this and '诞辰' (dàn chén), which is formal and usually reserved for historical figures or very senior people.
